architecture.factorization_representation: SAT prefix-sum automata with occurrence-to-bin variables
architecture.rank_two_control_symmetry: fixed span basis plus literal GL(r,5) matrix-action enumeration; no Engine-A canonicalizer import

certificate_policy.sat: explicit disjoint occurrence-index bins, independently resummed
certificate_policy.unsat: deterministic DIMACS-CNF bytes plus CNF semantic digest and DRUP trace; each UNSAT remains CANNOT_CHECK until externally checked
certificate_policy.external_checker: source-pinned drat-trim protocol; materialized negative control is engineering-only and does not check a full census bundle

d4_policy.full_closure_requirement: every remaining mathematical stratum plus complete audited reduction

input_coverage_policy: hash-bound declaration plus separate proof audit; CR-B must independently generate full matrix/candidate/orbit manifests and must not wrap Engine-A canonicalized candidates or forbidden sets; declaration alone is not completeness authority
